comment: Repo-level build-infrastructure dependencies that are not per-task workload libraries (those live in each task's TASK.json under `libraries`). Hand-maintained; consumed by scripts/gen_third_party_notices.py for validation and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md generation.

dependencies.name: OpenCL-Headers
dependencies.used_for: OpenCL API headers for the GPU tasks' OpenCL runner backend.

dependencies.name: Vulkan-Headers
dependencies.used_for: Vulkan API headers for the GPU tasks' Vulkan compute runner backend.

dependencies.name: oneAPI Level Zero
dependencies.used_for: Level Zero loader/headers for the GPU tasks' oneAPI runner backend. Vendors spdlog headers (MIT) and small XLA-derived parts (Apache-2.0) internally.

dependencies.name: hwinfo
dependencies.used_for: Hardware detection library; pinned as a submodule as a candidate replacement for common/cpp cpu topology detection (not yet linked by any task).
